about_the_game:
About "Rotten Life"

Core Game Features

▸ Hardcore Side-scrolling Action × Roguelike Adventure

Classic arcade-style controls, with a focus on a realistic combat system:​

Sparks from clashing swords, staggering recoil when hit, weight differences between weapons—every detail is designed to immerse you in the high-stakes thrill of "fighting for your life with every strike."​

No flashy over-the-top effects here. Instead, we use realistic limb-damage detection and hit feedback to make every battle feel like a do-or-die gamble.

▸ Brutal Mercenary Survival Simulation

Play as a downtrodden mercenary broken by war, and traverse a vivid medieval landscape.​

From plague-ridden villages and fallen castles to cursed dungeons, use your hard-earned bounties to upgrade your equipment or master more powerful combat moves.

▸ Explore Dark Underground Worlds (In Development)

Current Demo version includes: 4 main weapon styles / freely customizable combo system

Full version will add: rich random events / mechanical traps and puzzles / legendary Boss battles (your feedback will directly influence development priorities!)

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains some adult-related content, with specific details as follows:
1、Violent/Bloody Elements: The game features a small amount of bloody imagery, which may include visual content such as character injuries and minor blood depictions in combat scenes. This content is intended to serve the game's plot atmosphere and gameplay design, without excessive exaggeration or graphic portrayal.
2、Sexual Content: The game does not contain any sexual content, sexual imagery, or related suggestive elements throughout, adhering to a healthy content orientation.
3、Other Sensitive Content: The game does not include any depictions of or gameplay involving drugs or alcohol, nor does it contain content that encourages or depicts self-harm behavior, ensuring no negative guidance for players.
